## Orientation

Worktree: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/web-dashboard` (branch `phase/web-dashboard`, base `main`). Run every command there. That worktree is the only checkout for code changes this phase; do not write code in the primary checkout.

Territory: you own everything under `dashboard/web/ui/`. A parallel task (`web-read-api`) owns the Python under `dashboard/web/` in this same worktree at the same time — do not create or edit `dashboard/web/*.py` or anything else directly under `dashboard/web/`. Do not edit any file under `tests/`. Do not call `adaptive-artifacts`; you have no store access.

Concurrency warning: `web-read-api` runs concurrently in this same worktree and branch. When you commit, stage only your own paths (never `git add -A` across the whole tree), and retry once if `index.lock` is held.

Operational orientation:
- Node and npm are available on PATH (node v24, npm 11). Create the app under `dashboard/web/ui/` and run `npm install` there before running vitest.
- Read-only reference lives in the primary checkout, not in this worktree: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/spikes/web-dashboard/` (`index.html`, `app.js`, `styles.css`, `static/`) is the design mock, including its light/dark tokens. Use it as the styling reference; do not copy files from it verbatim into the worktree.
- The work-item `## Approach` below is the implementation recipe. Follow it.

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R31: The Vite dev server proxies /api to the FastAPI server.
R35: A fresh load of the page uses the light theme.
R36: A theme control switches the document between the dark theme and the light theme.

## Approach

- Create `dashboard/web/ui` as a Vite, Svelte 5, TypeScript, and Tailwind app. The npm `test` script is not required; acceptances call `vitest` through `npm exec`.
- Tailwind dark mode uses the `dark` class on `document.documentElement`. A fresh load leaves that class off. A theme control adds it and removes it. Dark colors follow the spike's `html[data-theme="dark"]` tokens.
- `vite` `server.proxy` forwards `/api` to the FastAPI port. Hash routes render an empty shell.
- Make the R31, R35, and R36 cases in `dashboard/web/ui/src/scaffold.test.ts` pass.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R31: The Vite dev server proxies /api to the FastAPI server.
R35: A fresh load of the page uses the light theme.
R36: A theme control switches the document between the dark theme and the light theme.

### Design / decisions (quote)

Design `## Invariants`:
- Store reads go through `dashboard.model`. Store writes go through `dashboard.dismiss` and `dashboard.backlog`.
- The listen address is 127.0.0.1.
- The write API does not accept a signer.
- The API does not send `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`.

Design `## Assumptions`:
- `dashboard-package-layout` still holds: this code lives under `dashboard/`, not a new top-level app and not in `orchestra/`.
- `dashboard-deps` still holds for the terminal. The web launcher has its own PEP 723 header.
- The spike's GET shapes are the contract the Svelte app codes against.

Decisions:
- `web-dashboard-toolchain`: Vite and Svelte over the spike JSON API
- `web-dashboard-styling`: Tailwind on the spike screen map
- `web-dashboard-theme`: Light by default, with a control that switches the whole page to dark and back
